senses.gloss: f. (cmp. כְּרֵישָׁה) a porraceous plant.—בורית כ׳ an alkaline solution of carshina.
units: <cite ref="Keritot 6a:52">Ker. 6ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 4:5:2">Y. Yoma IV, 41ᵈ</cite>.—Pl. <cite ref="K01277"><he>כַּרְשִׁינִים</he></cite>, <he>כַּרְשִׁינִין</he>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 1:5">Sabb. I, 5</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 17b:6">17ᵇ</cite>) <he>אין שורין … וכ׳ אלא וכ׳</he> (shortly before Sabbath) we must not lay in ink-material, … or alkaline plants; [comment. refer to next w.].
